item.title: The area especially outside O'Neill's is filthy dirty with alcohol spills and sometimes food spills., 22nd August
item.description:
The local council has spent millions of pounds on "improving" the pavements but they always seem to look a filthy mess! It just seems a waste of money if they are not going to be cleaned regularly. Is it possible for the local businesses that profit from the night time economy and local cafes which have outside seating (which is all great for the area) to contribute towards the cost of regular cleaning or can they be made responsible for cleaning areas of the high street. It is all great during the night time and people are out enjoying themselves but during the day time the people shopping and using the high street as a "destination".... which Beckenham is great for! These people and local residents have to put up with the messy and filthy pavements.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): High Street, Beckenham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Loads of rubbish inside Overground tracks fence (Weaver Line), 22nd August
item.description:
